北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天阳光正好，风有些凉，出门别忘了添衣哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but a bit cool. Remember to layer up when you go out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感舒适。湿度较高，心情也要保持晴朗呀。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast with comfortable temps. High humidity, but keep your spirits bright!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感很舒适。湿度大，出门记得带把伞哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels pleasant. High humidity, don't forget your umbrella!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，暖和又潮湿。注意防潮，保持好心情。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, warm, and humid. Mind the dampness and stay cheerful!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感温暖。湿度大，注意衣物防潮哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast and warm. High humidity, remember to keep clothes dry!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感稍凉。出门时可以加件薄外套哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast and feels a bit cool. Consider a light jacket when heading out!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感舒适。风力适中，好好享受今日吧。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast and feels comfortable. Enjoy your day!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，微风不燥。湿度稍高，记得多喝水。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, calm. Slightly high humidity, remember to drink more water.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉下雨啦，体感舒适。出门记得带好雨具，注意安全。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: It's raining in Wuhan, and feels pleasant. Don't forget your umbrella and stay safe!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，气温适中。湿度很高，注意保持干燥哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy with moderate temps. Very high humidity, remember to stay dry!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感舒适。湿度较高，出门记得带把伞。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast and feels comfortable. High humidity, remember your umbrella.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨有雾且冷，能见度低。驾车注意安全，保暖要做好。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is foggy and cold with low visibility. Drive safely and stay warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳下雨气温低，体感更冷。记得添衣保暖，别着凉。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is rainy and cold. Remember to layer up to stay warm and avoid catching a cold.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，气温宜人。湿度高，出门别忘了带把伞。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy with pleasant temps. High humidity, don't forget your umbrella!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感温暖。湿度较高，注意保持室内通风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast and feels warm. High humidity, remember to ventilate indoors.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，北风微凉。出门别忘了加件外套哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is overcast with a cool north wind. Remember to wear a jacket when you go out!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，风大体感冷。请务必穿暖和，注意防风。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast, windy, and feels cold. Please dress warmly and protect against the wind.
